speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Extraction transport clear of the caldera rim. Core temperature exceeding 12,000 Kelvin. Geothermal containment failure is total.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: Look down at the rift. The entire foundation is buckling! The plasma conduits we severed are feeding thermal feedback straight into their power grid.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: The coolant reservoirs broke their banks! Flash steam is choking the subterranean flues... the river is reclaiming its bed beneath the stone.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: The harmonic hum... it's spiking into ultrasonic dissonance! Listen to the sky—the resonance field that held this city under glass is tearing itself apart!

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Look at the horizon! The sky-shield emitter towers along Sector 4 are arcing! The hexagonal lattice is fracturing!

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA // COMMS: Telemetry confirmed across all civilian bands! The planetary sky-shield grid has collapsed over Neo-Kyoto! The Citadel's iron dome is gone!

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Ten years under their simulated twilight. For ten years, the Citadel Spire ruled from behind an untouchable shield. No more.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Look up at the Spire. Without their shield, their guns are blind to low-altitude strikes. The high docks at Stratos are wide open to an air assault.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Act Two is finished. Regroup at the rim, rearm the squad, and prepare for high-altitude insertion. Next stop: Stratos Docks!
